recommended_architecture.raw_byte_plane: Private Backblaze B2 S3-compatible bucket, pending explicit user approval and account setup
recommended_architecture.why: GitHub stores code, frozen protocols, manifests, hashes, acquisition metadata, and research commits; B2 stores the reconstructable raw bytes independently. Git LFS is retained as a tested fallback/control-plane option but is not recommended as the sole raw-byte archive for this dataset.

estimated_size_and_cost.basis: Prior project storage observations and signed-flow archive estimates; exact size must be measured during acquisition and recorded per object.
estimated_size_and_cost.b2_storage_rate_reference: $6.95/TB/month, first 10GB free per current Backblaze pricing page
estimated_size_and_cost.b2_estimated_storage_cost_usd_per_month: approximately $0.09-$0.15 for 21-30 GiB after the first 10GB free, excluding tax and any pricing changes
estimated_size_and_cost.b2_upload_cost: $0 for upload bandwidth and Class A upload calls per current pricing documentation
estimated_size_and_cost.b2_restore_cost: one full 21-26 GiB restore is within the stated 3x monthly-average-storage free egress allowance; additional egress is published at $0.01/GB
estimated_size_and_cost.github_lfs_free_allowance: 10 GiB storage and 10 GiB monthly download bandwidth on Free plan
estimated_size_and_cost.github_lfs_estimated_overage: for 21-26 GiB, approximately 11-16 GiB storage overage at $0.07/GiB-month and one full restore overage at $0.0875/GiB, subject to GitHub billing/plan rules
estimated_size_and_cost.github_lfs_published_addon_reference: $5/month for 50 GB storage and bandwidth on current GitHub pricing page
estimated_size_and_cost.cost_decision: No paid service is activated in this task. B2 is the recommended raw-byte plane because the expected monthly cost is very low, uploads/API calls are free, and it is independent of Git history.

exact_object_layout.bucket: private bucket name supplied only after user approval

git_layout.git_lfs_policy: Do not use Git LFS as the sole raw-byte store; use only as a controlled fallback or dry-run provider unless explicitly selected.

credentials.runtime_method: Environment variables or a user-managed secret/connector mechanism; credentials must never appear in command arguments, logs, manifests, or Git history.
credentials.current_task_state: No B2 credentials are configured. No paid account has been created. After a sandbox reset, credentials must be re-supplied unless the user configures a durable secret mechanism; inaccessible cloud bytes are treated as unavailable.

per_batch_sequence: Acquire only the next batch from official Bybit URLs
Validate archive format and per-day integrity
Compute SHA-256 and compare with the newly created re-acquisition manifest
Upload raw bytes to the private object store
Commit manifests and batch metadata to GitHub
Push the commit to authenticated GitHub remote
Fresh-workspace object download and SHA-256 verification
Stop immediately on any failure before the next batch

fresh_workspace: Clone the GitHub repository at the manifest commit
Verify the expected provenance_id and manifest commit SHA
Load object-store credentials from the approved secret mechanism
Download each object by exact manifest key
Recompute SHA-256 and compare with the committed manifest
Refuse any object with missing key, size mismatch, metadata mismatch, or hash mismatch
Only then expose raw bytes to validation code
restore.independent_recoverability: GitHub must restore metadata/manifests independently; object storage must restore bytes independently. Neither side is considered sufficient alone.

retention.raw_objects: Retain indefinitely for this research baseline; no deletion or overwrite of v1 objects.
retention.manifests: Retain all versions and commits; never rewrite original re-acquisition metadata.
retention.object_versioning: Enable versioning or immutable retention if available and approved on the selected provider.
retention.new_baseline_rule: Because the prior historical hashes are unrecoverable, this is a new provenance baseline and must never claim byte identity with the lost dataset.

dry_run.provider: GitHub Git LFS controlled dry-run, because no B2 account or credentials are available and no paid service may be activated without approval
dry_run.limitation: A provider-specific B2 dry-run remains required before selecting B2 for real data; the Git LFS dry-run validates the repository/cloud/restore control sequence without activating paid storage.

required_before_real_acquisition: explicit approval for any paid storage
